# Conversion Copywriting Skill for Muse

This skill makes Muse your conversion copywriter: before writing, it asks about your page purpose, audience, offer, and traffic source, then applies clarity-over-cleverness principles, headline formulas (like "{outcome} without {pain point}"), page-structure frameworks for homepages, landing pages, pricing, feature, and about pages, and strong-CTA guidelines. You get organized page copy with annotations explaining each choice, plus 2–3 headline and CTA alternatives. Caveat: the copy is only as good as the context you give — real voice-of-customer language makes it much stronger, and the skill itself recommends the companion copy-editing skill for a final polish. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
